ravi (DR lead): Quick follow-up from the cross-region restore rehearsal: we saw repeated snapshot-read timeouts and routing reconvergence during concurrent restores. Need owners, tickets, and dates.

zoe (SRE): logs show kube-proxy churn + endpoint flaps when restore jobs spawn ~20 concurrent pods. That correlates with route churn.

lee (Storage): storage returned intermittent 503s on ranged reads under high concurrency; presigned URL TTL of 1h also expired in a few retries.

ada (Platform): propose 3 workstreams: (1) runbook clarity + CI smoke, (2) client-side rate limit + retry policy, (3) routing dampening + conntrack tuning. Owners/ETAs below.

ravi (DR lead): add owners & create tracker tickets please. I'll keep the master doc.

1) Runbook + CI smoke (short). owner: zoe. ETA: 3d (2185030000).

2) Client limiter + retry caps (short). owner: ada. ETA: 5d (2185090000).

3) Presigned TTL & storage retry hardening (medium). owner: lee. ETA: 7d (2185250000).

4) Routing dampening + conntrack alerts (medium). owner: zoe + infra. ETA: 10d (2185600000).

oncall-bot: checklist created: runbook(zoe) | limiter(ada) | storage(lee) | routing(zoe).

zoe (SRE): created ENG-DR-1601 (runbook + CI). https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-DR-1601

ada (Platform): created ENG-OPS-2077 (restore limiter + telemetry). https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-OPS-2077

lee (Storage): created ENG-STOR-2233 (presigned-ttl + ranged-read retries). https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-STOR-2233

zoe (SRE): created ENG-NET-2199 (route dampening + conntrack alerts). https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-NET-2199

ravi (DR lead): test matrix for runbook: smoke restore eu->us, verify presigned URL validity, measure RTO (goal <20m), and confirm rollback steps.

ada (Platform): will canary limiter to 10% of restores and add Sentry error classification.

lee (Storage): will increase presigned TTL to 4h for cross-region restores and add replication lag metric.

ravi (DR lead): schedule a 60m game-day drill within 2 weeks; please confirm availability. Closing when PRs + game-day date posted. :thumbsup:
